nextStoryContext: US-003 added appendOutcomeOnMain + mapWorkerOutcomeToStatus to src/commands/pattern-records.ts. appendOutcomeOnMain(options: {cwd, recordId, status, spawnFn, clockFn?}) locates the ONE record whose fingerprintPatternRecord(record) === recordId (recomputed per line, same as the US-002 dedup path -- no stored id field), appends {status, recorded_at} to its outcomes[], and re-serializes ONLY that one line (JSON.stringify); every other line, including blanks, is pushed back byte-for-byte. A recordId with no matching line is a structured {ok:false, reason:'not-found'} (mirrors dismissSuggestionOnMain in suggestions.ts) -- looked up BEFORE the CAS loop starts, so no throw and no commit fires. The CAS per-attempt recompute callback re-reads pattern-records.jsonl from the advanced main on every retry and re-locates the target line by fingerprint against that fresh content (same discipline as appendPatternRecordOnMain / CAM-300). mapWorkerOutcomeToStatus(kind: WorkerOutcomeKind) maps pass->success, incomplete->partial, fail|blocked->failure, unknown|no-commit->null (documented no-op: callers must skip calling appendOutcomeOnMain when the mapping returns null -- no evidence the pattern was exercised, so no outcome is recorded rather than skewing confirmationScore). WorkerOutcomeKind is imported as a type-only import from src/supervisor/result.ts (result.ts has zero dependency back on src/commands/, so no circular import). US-004 (prune/demotion gate, confirmationScore-driven) is the next consumer: it will read records via readPatternRecordsFromMain, decide which recordId/outcome to append (likely wiring mapWorkerOutcomeToStatus + appendOutcomeOnMain into the supervisor's post-story hook, or a `cam patterns record-outcome` CLI command -- neither exists yet, this story only shipped the writer + mapper, not a caller), and add the actual prune/decay logic consuming confirmationScore thresholds.
